title: Saved & Favorites
description: ADDED 2026-08-13 (direct source read, previously only 1 of its 4 real tabs was documented — as `marketplace_saved_bookmarks` under the `marketplace` flow, which remains accurate for that one tab). `SavedAndFavoritesFlow` (SupportingScreens.kt:1023, reached from the dashboard's Saved shortcut) is the actual hub — `SavedTab` enum: ARTISTS, BANDS, STUDIOS, MARKETPLACE (+ EMPTY state), grid/list view toggle, per-tab remove action. All four tabs are 100% local `mutableStateListOf` mock data (hardcoded artists/studios/marketplace items) — zero Firestore reads or writes, no persisted "saved" relationship on any real document.
